posts.text: 今天泡了一壶新茶，配月饼刚好。
posts.gloss: Brewed a pot of new tea today. Perfect with mooncakes.

posts.text: 早高峰骑车上班，比地铁还快。
posts.gloss: Biked to work in rush hour. Faster than the subway.

posts.text: 样本河边的工地，听说工资还没发。
posts.gloss: The building site by Sample River has not paid wages in three months. Workers went to demand their pay today.

posts.text: 周末去放风筝，天气太好了。
posts.gloss: Flew a kite this weekend. Gorgeous weather.

posts.text: 暴雨之后虚构县的老桥倒塌了，救援队还在找人。
posts.gloss: After the heavy rain, the old bridge in Fictional County collapsed. Rescue teams are still searching for people.

posts.text: 示例小区烂尾三年，业主们商量要不要停贷。
posts.gloss: Our Sample Estate housing project has sat unfinished for three years. Homeowners are discussing stopping mortgage payments.

posts.text: 示例市医院发烧门诊排了四个小时，病人都坐在走廊。
posts.gloss: The fever clinic at a Sample City hospital had a four-hour line. Patients were sitting in the hallway.

posts.text: 今天的牛肉面加了新辣椒，欢迎来尝。
posts.gloss: Added a new chili to today's beef noodles. Come try it.

posts.text: 虚构县学校食堂用过期的肉，家长们在群里都炸了。
posts.gloss: A school cafeteria in Fictional County used expired meat. Parents in the group chat are furious.
